release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.23 tightens the bottom action dock on every table (smaller action-button padding, shorter sizing/spot rows, and less outer spacing) so the table felt gains vertical room. VIP is rebuilt as a lavish ruby-red and gold Private Club: double gold rails, ruby felt, crowned crest, dedicated lobby and buy-in flow, and gold/red controls. All five seats remain PRO ONLY at CPU level 5; the VIP simulation budget doubles from 256 to 512, and VIP-only postflop range/showdown equity sampling increases by 50% with finer EV comparison. The immutable 174-scenario preflop policy and normal Rush CPU strategy settings are unchanged. This remains a stronger local strategy, not solver-exact GTO.
